user.title: Configure SMB Share Manager
user.description: This integration allows you to manage SMB shares, disks and Samba users.

abort.already_configured: SMB Share Manager is already configured

detect_disks.title: Detect disks
detect_disks.description: Click Submit to detect all connected disks. Results will be available in Home Assistant events (smb_manager_disks_detected).

mount_disk.title: Mount a disk
mount_disk.description: Select a disk to mount from the detected unmounted disks.

unmount_disk.title: Unmount a disk
unmount_disk.description: Select a disk to unmount from the mounted disks.

create_share.title: Create SMB share
create_share.description: Create a new SMB share by specifying the name, path and options.

delete_share.title: Delete SMB share
delete_share.description: Select a share to delete from the configured shares.

list_shares.title: List SMB shares
list_shares.description: Click Submit to list all configured SMB shares. Results will be available in Home Assistant events (smb_manager_shares_listed).

add_user.title: Add Samba user
add_user.description: Add a new Samba user with a username and password.

delete_user.title: Delete Samba user
delete_user.description: Delete an existing Samba user by specifying their username.

restart_samba.title: Restart Samba
restart_samba.description: Click Submit to restart Samba services (smbd and nmbd).
